name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €88/MWh on 20 Nov, above the €70 Alert line, as Gulf shipping attacks continue
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €88.45/MWh on 20 Nov, 4.4% higher on the week, about a third higher over three months and above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Attacks on shipping near the Strait of Hormuz, including a tanker incident with military forces on 22 Nov (Euronews), keep Gulf LNG flows at risk going into winter.
for_you: Wholesale gas prices this high tend to feed through to household energy bills and industrial costs over the following months.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF natural gas futures (TTF=F)
Euronews — Tanker incident 'involving military forces' reported in Strait of Hormuz

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
